title: Council Bluffs, May 1866: the captain
summary: You are Elias Mercer, elected captain of thirty-eight wagons bound for Oregon. The grass is up, the company is restless, and every one of them will look to you when things go wrong.

playerSlot.summary: You make your own captain of the Mercer company: thirty-eight wagons bound for Oregon from Council Bluffs, who elected you to get them there.
knows: The company is bound for Oregon City by the Platte, South Pass and Fort Hall, and the old hands say a train must pass Independence Rock by the Fourth of July to beat the snow.

roles.label: Captain of the company

opening:
Dawn on the Missouri bottoms at Council Bluffs, and thirty-eight wagons are drawn up in a ring on the trampled grass, their canvas grey with dew. Oxen low at the picket line. Somewhere a child is crying and somebody is already arguing about the order of march.

You have the company's ledger open on your knees in the lead wagon: names, wagons, rifles, flour by the hundredweight. It adds up, nearly.

Wilhelm Brandt is at the tailboard, hat in his hands. "Captain. The Brandts were promised the front of the line this week. Mr. Kell says it is his turn." Behind him Jasper Kell leans on a wheel and grins.
